sara_cs: Orchid Labs asked for a 90m enablement workshop next Wed or Thu. They want hands-on on fine-tuning + cost controls. Can we slot them? :calendar:

mike_csm: I'm available Wed 10:00-12:00 PT. Thu afternoon is tight for me.

jordan_enable: I can do Wed. suggest agenda: 1) onboarding checklist, 2) demo: Redwood console and rollouts, 3) hands-on labs for model config + batching. Want a dry run?

lee_onboarding: Heads-up: their org has limited infra access. Need to confirm whether they can deploy private connector. If not, we'll use hosted sandbox.

anita_success: Renewal at EoQ is flagged green but adoption low. This workshop is high priority. Would love to include a short segment on metrics they should track post-workshop.

sara_cs: Proposed times: Wed 10-11:30 PT (preferred), Thu 1-2:30 PT (backup). Who can lead hands-on lab?

jordan_enable: I can lead lab if we have a preconfigured sandbox. Can devex prep a notebook + sample dataset? @mike_csm can you ask Orchids to share test data or consent to synthetic data?

mike_csm: I'll ask. Also adding invitees: CTO (lee@orchidlabs.com), ML Eng (sam), Prod Ops (natalie). Anyone else?

sara_cs: Add customer success rep on their side, and legal for the data share approval if needed.

ops-bot: calendar event created: https://cal.example.com/event/abc123 — tentative. Needs final confirm.

jordan_enable: Draft agenda:
```
- 10:00 intro + outcomes
- 10:10 Redwood Console walkthrough (15m)
- 10:25 Quick model config + batching demo (20m)
- 10:45 Hands-on lab (30m)
- 11:15 Q&A + next steps (15m)
```

anita_success: Nice. Add a 5m "success metrics" slide after Q&A.

sara_cs: Ok locking Wed 10-11:30 PT if Mike confirms test data by EOD tomorrow. If not, shift to Thu 1.

mike_csm: Got it — pinging them now. will update thread.

sara_cs: Thx everyone :thumbsup:
